what: The photo-alt dictionary CFM builds with `manage.py photo_alt_dictionary --write`, copied byte for byte from CFM master. It maps every Slovak tail of a gallery alt (`name – tail`) to the tail in 9 languages (cs de pl hu ro fr it es en) and the word for "photo"; src/lib/photo-alt/index.ts builds the foreign-market alt from it. A newer dictionary is copied in the same way: replace the file and update this record.
rule: self_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the JSON with sorted keys, indent 1, ensure_ascii off and without the self_sha256 key.
